COMBAT_ENHANCEMENTS.setting.reflow.label: Enable initiative reflow
COMBAT_ENHANCEMENTS.setting.reflow.descr: If initiatives are tied, renumber the encounter in the requested order using consecutive integers. This replaces decimal tie breakers.
COMBAT_ENHANCEMENTS.setting.showHPForTyp: World setting, shared by all players. Configure under your own GM account. All combatants shows every valid HP circle in the tracker. Actor-type choices add that type to normal token visibility; Bar Brawl visibility rules still apply.
COMBAT_ENHANCEMENTS.setting.enableHpFiel: Enable an editable HP field in the combat tracker for GMs and actor owners.
COMBAT_ENHANCEMENTS.setting.enableHpRadi: Enables HP circles on combat tracker portraits. Players follow Player HP circle visibility and token Bar 1 visibility; GMs always see valid circles when enabled. Bar Brawl visibility rules still apply.
COMBAT_ENHANCEMENTS.setting.removeTarget: Clear your targets when the active encounter changes turn or round, or ends. Applies immediately without reloading.
COMBAT_ENHANCEMENTS.setting.hideNonAllyI: Hide non-ally initiative from players on FVTT combat tracker
COMBAT_ENHANCEMENTS.hp.label: HP
COMBAT_ENHANCEMENTS.invalidHp: Enter a number or a signed change such as -10 or +3.
COMBAT_ENHANCEMENTS.updateFailed: The update failed. Check permissions and the browser console for details.
COMBAT_ENHANCEMENTS.rollInitiativeFirst: Roll or enter initiative for all combatants before reordering.
COMBAT_ENHANCEMENTS.initiativeReflowRequ: These initiatives are tied. Enable initiative reflow to place a combatant between them.
COMBAT_ENHANCEMENTS.unsupportedTurnOrder: This system uses a custom turn order that cannot be rearranged by initiative.
COMBAT_ENHANCEMENTS.groupInitiative: Change this group's shared initiative using the system's group controls.
